title: Kamil Lesniak et Valérie Arsenault remportent le QMT135 — TVA CIMT-CHAU
claims: The 2026 QMT135 was the 14th edition of the Québec Mega Trail; 315 athletes took part and the race started at 20:00 on Friday 3 July at the Hôtel & Spa Le Germain Charlevoix.
Kamil Lesniak won the men's QMT135 in about 16:40 and Valérie Arsenault won the women's race in about 18:12.
About 3,900 runners took part across the weekend, with 11 races from 1 km to 135 km.
The 2026 QMT135 course had close to 6,000 m of positive gain.
